summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight Materials ETF (RSPM) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 500 Equal Weighted / Materials index. The fund tracks an equal-weighted index of US materials companies in the S&P 500. RSPM was launched on Nov 1, 2006 and is issued by Invesco.

holdings.infoBox: RSPM is an equity ETF with a total of 28 individual holdings. The top holdings are Smurfit Westrock stock at 4.41%, The Sherwin-Williams Company at 4.32%, Packaging Corporation of America at 4.30%, Ecolab at 4.28%, and Linde at 4.25%.
